ground_truth_policy: Source-level relevance, manually authored from the frozen corpus BEFORE any retriever was run. split_policy: DEV is used for baseline reporting now and may be used by a future phase to tune fusion; HOLDOUT is frozen after GraphRAG-04 approval and must not be tuned on. Both are evaluated for the 04 baseline.
